work.description: The act erects Korea as a vicariate apostolic independent of the bishop of Peking. Issuer evidence GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF8576; own dating clause LF8646–8649 reads: Datum Romae apud:s. Mariam Maiorem, sub annulo piscatoris die nona sept. millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo’ primo, pontificatus Nostri anno primo.. Own provenance note LF8652 excluded as edition furniture. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
